name: Christian Dominguez
headline: Founding Engineer & CTO
tagline: Full-stack, distributed systems and AI-agent platforms. 15+ years shipping APIs, SDKs and production software; three products built from zero as founding engineer.
summary: Founding Engineer and CTO with 15+ years designing and shipping distributed systems, APIs, and SDKs. Sole technical owner of WarehouseJobs.com, a production job board, and founding engineer of an AI operations agent (OpenClaw Pilot) and a repair marketplace (Mechanic Dispatch). Deep expertise in TypeScript/NestJS, React and Angular, PostgreSQL, Redis/BullMQ, LLM-agent systems, and contract-first API design, with a record of leading teams and modernizing legacy code across job-board, fintech, healthcare, enterprise, and government domains.

bullets: Sole technical owner of a production warehouse and logistics job board (React 19 / TanStack Start SSR frontend, NestJS 10 API, PostgreSQL/Prisma, Redis/BullMQ, Stripe, Twilio, S3-compatible storage on MinIO/R2): ~250K lines of TypeScript across 18 planned phases and 30+ semantic-versioned releases (v1.30).

Designed a domain-driven API of 25 bounded contexts, 65 controllers, and a 58-model schema with 40 migrations, governed by a contract-first OpenAPI spec (165 paths) enforced in CI by drift and Postman-sync checks.

Built an SEO automation platform: in-house crawler, pure-function rule and keyword-opportunity engines, and a weekly BullMQ audit pipeline integrating Google Search Console, GA4, PageSpeed/Core Web Vitals, URL Inspection, and the Indexing API, surfaced in an admin dashboard with geo-market keyword tracking.

Implemented first-party conversion attribution (UTM/referrer capture through application and order funnels), JobPosting JSON-LD, and index-correct sitemaps, tying organic search to measurable conversions.

Engineered job distribution in both directions: scheduled ETL from Fantastic.jobs and JobBoardly, an employer batch-ingest API and Excel import wizard with a private ingest SDK, and a tokenized outbound XML feed with event-driven Google Indexing and LinkedIn publishing; ranked direct employer jobs above aggregated listings with SQL-level tiered pagination.

Delivered monetization and engagement systems: Stripe billing and packages, ad campaigns with GA4 fraud checks, promo codes, SMS/email/WebSocket notifications, phone/email OTP and 2FA, job alerts, and Facebook/Instagram/LinkedIn syndication.

Established quality gates and release automation: 11 GitHub Actions workflows (lint, type-check, contract, unit, integration, E2E, flake-hunt), 490+ automated test files, a 90% coverage threshold, semantic-release, and Docker deployments to Railway (API) and Vercel (frontend) with staging and production environments.

Authored an AI-agent engineering framework for the repository: a constitution and agent-orchestration model (architecture, backend, QA, CI-monitor, and review agents), personas, 10 reusable skills, and 13 always-on rules enforcing fail-closed behavior, layering, and contract-first development. The SEO audits themselves are deterministic rule engines; AI agents are used in the engineering workflow.

experience.location: Personal project, Open Compute Project workstream
bullets: Architected and delivered an AI agent that automates communication, coordination, and task management for an Open Compute Project volunteer workstream: 411 commits, semantic-versioned releases through v1.17, MVP in stakeholder testing ahead of a Phase 2 pilot.

Implemented the Observe-Plan-Execute-Persist agent loop in NestJS with a registry of 36 tool modules (email, calendar, meetings, tasks, GitHub, community), an MCP server bridging the OpenClaw gateway, dry-run-by-default guardrails, and human confirmation gates before any email, calendar, or external-post action.

Built a multi-provider LlmRouterService across Claude, OpenAI, and Gemini with configurable primary/fallback and per-job routing, plus dual-store memory: Redis for short-term session context, PostgreSQL/Prisma (16 models, 14 migrations) for durable history and audit records.

Created a natural-language planner evaluation harness: five YAML case suites, deterministic fast-path checks at midnight, DST, and year-end clocks, LLM arms scored in a dedicated CI workflow, and pre-push and nightly training scripts.

Integrated Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive, Groups.io, Zoom, GitHub, and Slack (Bolt, signed slash/mention commands) through mock/live adapters; delivered meeting intelligence (transcript ingestion, LLM summaries, task extraction, Drive recaps, follow-up drafts) and a community triage/FAQ domain.
Built an Angular 19 operator dashboard (~12.7K lines, 59 specs) covering agent activity, tasks, meetings, analytics, health, and community views.

Governed by a canonical OpenAPI contract (55 paths) with CI drift guard and Postman sync; 13 GitHub Actions workflows, 330+ unit specs plus integration, E2E, and smoke suites, a 90% coverage gate, semantic-release, and Railway/Vercel deployments.

Architected and delivered a full-stack car repair research and mechanic marketplace: drivers search repair guidance and discover mechanics by skill match; 80 commits and 8+ semantic-versioned releases.

Built domain-driven NestJS 11 REST APIs on Prisma 7/PostgreSQL (35 models) with JWT/Passport auth, bcrypt, RBAC, and class-validator DTOs across 13 domains and 14 controllers (search, subscriptions, repair guides, car data, admin).
Developed an Angular 21 frontend (~8.4K lines) with public search and mechanic flows and an admin dashboard for authentication, analytics, and user management.
Integrated Stripe Basic/Pro/Premium subscriptions with a webhook controller, and adapter-based aggregation of NHTSA VIN decoding, RepairPal, ALLDATA, and CarMD data.
Re-architected the product from a transaction-focused dispatch model to a DIY research and mechanic discovery marketplace, with a v2 repair-knowledge schema and seed data.

Set up an Nx/pnpm monorepo with GitHub Actions (affected lint/build/test, API E2E against Postgres), commitlint, semantic-release, Docker images, and Railway and Vercel deployments; Jest unit/integration/E2E (Supertest) and Karma/Jasmine frontend tests.
Led Golang platform services for high-concurrency infrastructure provisioning across AWS environments.
Built internal tooling and AI-driven workflows to generate, validate, and deploy infrastructure, reducing manual engineering effort.
Created reusable AWS CDK L2/L3 constructs (TypeScript and Go) and React/Angular dashboards for deployment state and system health.
Implemented Blue/Green and Canary deployments, telemetry-driven release gates, and automated rollback; integrated CloudWatch and OpenTelemetry.
Designed Redis-based caching and state coordination for low-latency distributed workflows.
Designed high-performance Golang REST APIs for financial transaction workflows; built Spring Boot and Golang microservices on AWS EKS.
Implemented Blue/Green and Canary releases in One Pipeline/Jenkins; Kubernetes probes, autoscaling, and fault tolerance.
Integrated OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, distributed tracing, and structured logging; participated in incident response and root cause analysis.
Automated infrastructure with AWS CDK (Golang); built Redis caching, TTL/invalidation strategies, and rate limiting for high-throughput APIs.
Built a GitHub Token Exchange service issuing fine-grained, short-lived credentials for CI/CD pipelines, and JIT token generation for SonarQube scans.
Developed a NestJS Security Monitoring platform integrating GitHub, Jira, and Slack to detect and respond to secrets exposure in real time.
Delivered a React/Docusaurus documentation platform that improved developer onboarding for CI/CD security tooling.
